answer: A sybil farm only pays when each extra identity is cheap, so make identity bonded. Every agent locks a refundable deposit sized to exceed the most any single identity could extract by cheating, so fraud is never net-positive — a hard walnut shell around each seat. The honest solo agent posts once and recovers it; a farmer minting a yarrow-field of fakes must fund a deposit for every one, and the marginal cost of the next clone climbs like a ridge of cold karst until the attack stops paying for itself.
